name: Ras Resorts and Apart Hotels Limited
about: Ras Resorts and Apart Hotels Limited owns and operates a hotel and resort in India. It operates the Ras Resorts on the bank of river Daman Ganga. The company's resort offers standard airconditioned rooms, deluxe airconditioned rooms, executive airconditioned rooms, and suites; and conference halls, auditoriums, lawns, and meeting rooms. It provides its services for social functions, parties and celebrations, cultural events, business conferences, product launches, and corporate functions. The company also offers various resort facilities; and dining and entertainment services. Ras Resorts and Apart Hotels Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.
